  decision = {Each DVC stage has its own module under \texttt{recommenditos/\allowbreak{}data/\allowbreak{}} or \texttt{recommenditos/\allowbreak{}modeling/\allowbreak{}}, instead of the flat Cookiecutter Data Science layout with \texttt{dataset.\allowbreak{}py}, \texttt{features.\allowbreak{}py}, and \texttt{modeling/\allowbreak{}train.\allowbreak{}py}.

  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item The flat Cookiecutter layout as generated: download, preprocessing, and split would share one file, so an edit to it reruns every stage that depends on it.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} The course prescribes Cookiecutter Data Science and allows justified deviations.
A stage's \texttt{deps} should name the code that stage runs, so that \texttt{dvc repro} reruns the minimum.
One file per ticket also lets several people build a sequential pipeline in parallel.},
